title: AITEAM-X Agent Bundle Manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json inside an AITEAM-X agent bundle. One manifest per agent. Source of truth — _cfg/agent-manifest.csv is regenerated from this.

bundleVersion.description: Bundle schema version. Increments on breaking changes.

id.description: Unique agent id, kebab-case, 3-40 chars. Used in URLs, file paths, manifests.

title.description: Short professional title shown in the UI.

icon.description: Single emoji or short glyph fallback when visual.json glyphPath is unavailable.

module.description: Module the agent belongs to. Determines default location in the dashboard 2D scene.

version.description: Semantic version of THIS bundle (independent of platform version).

platformCompatibility.description: Semver range of AITEAM-X platform this bundle supports (e.g. '>=0.22.0').

workflows.description: IDs of workflows this agent ships with or depends on. Must exist in _cfg/workflow-manifest.csv after install.

uses.description: Tool ids the agent expects (snake_case per harness convention). Must be registered in lib/harness/tools/.

builtin.description: Platform-shipped bundle. Cannot be uninstalled. Reserved for INOSX-published bundles only.
